description: Container image of each ReplicaSet of one Kubernetes Deployment over the last 30 minutes, from the k8s_cluster receiver metrics, with the last time each ReplicaSet reported pods. Use it to find the image of the last healthy ReplicaSet before proposing a rollback, for example orders:1.4.0. The image is written as in the Deployment spec (Docker Hub library images without the docker.io/library/ prefix), so it can be passed as is to rollback_deployment.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-k8sclusterreceiver.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 30 minutes
    AND k8s.namespace.name == ?namespace AND k8s.deployment.name == ?deployment
    AND k8s.replicaset.name IS NOT NULL AND container.image.name IS NOT NULL
| EVAL image = CONCAT(REPLACE(container.image.name, "^docker\\.io/library/", ""), ":", resource.attributes.container.image.tag)
| STATS last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), pods = COUNT_DISTINCT(k8s.pod.name)
    BY k8s.replicaset.name, image
| SORT last_seen DESC
